title: Who was in the Young show
summary: Phillips lists the personnel: six chorus girls, the Young family, Pete Jones, Clarence Phillips, James Clark; the acts left behind.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: the show, including the band and everything. They had a big band. I think it was about... Let's see, there was seven in the band.
We ought to get that straight. We'll label your photographs later. But you said that in the carnival show they had about six girls or so -- dancers?
Then they had Lee Young, Lester Young and Irma Young.
Then Mrs. Young and you and Mr. Young...
Pete Jones. My brother, Clarence Phillips. James Clark playing clarinet. That's about it.
Now, that was the carnival show.
That was on both. He had the same amount of band on both. About 6-7 pieces, something like that.
Then, when you got into vaudeville, did you keep the chorus girls?
Yeah, oh yeah. We kept them.
Same personnel or was there any change?
Well, some comedians they didn't take...
Who were in the carnival show, but they didn't...
Who were in the carnival show that they didn't take. They didn't take one they called Shadow. He was
the guy that originated Shadow... That was an act in those days -- Shadow. And they didn't take Dirty Red.
